name: rv1106_sbc
description: LP-1106: Linux SBC on Rockchip RV1106G3 (Cortex-A7, 1 TOPS NPU, 256MB DDR3L in package). USB-C power+OTG, 10/100 Ethernet, SPI NAND boot, microSD, 2-lane MIPI CSI, debug UART, 2x10 GPIO.
requirements: 5V from USB-C (sink, 5.1k Rd), reverse-current Schottky to VSYS
Rails per RV1106 DS Table 3-2: VDD_0V9 0.81-0.95V, VCC_DDR 1.283-1.45V (DDR3L), VCC_1V8 1.62-1.98V, VCC_3V3 3.0-3.465V
Sequencing like Luckfox reference: 0.9V first, then DDR+1.8V (RC delay), then 3.3V
4-layer JLC 7628 stackup, single-sided assembly, In1=GND plane
Boot from SPI NAND (FSPI), microSD on SDMMC0, console UART2_M1 115200

F1.note: protects VSYS from shorts on the expansion header

constraints.note: FB divider close to FB pin
FB divider close to FB pin
FB divider close to FB pin
FB divider close to FB pin
regional VSYS pour under the power section (split plane)
0402/0603 decoupling may go under the SoC on the bottom

notes: ETH/CSI clearance 0.1: with 0.35 mm pin pitch a pair class needs track+2*clearance<=0.35 to escape; router necks down at the pins.
v2: double-sided assembly (SoC decoupling, ZQ/EXTR, crystal network allowed on bottom); routed with llm-pcb hroute + Freerouting completion
PWR_HI current_a=1.0: estimated board load ~3 W at 5 V (~0.6 A) incl. buck losses; 1 A rating with margin. Buck SW nodes carry inductor ripple ~0.5 A pk-pk on top of load.
